map.输入流量、扬程、轴功率，计算水泵有效功率、运行效率与能耗（水的密度 ρ=1000: From flow, head and shaft power, compute pump effective power, operating efficiency and energy use and cost (water density 1000 kg/m3, g = 9.81 m/s2).
map.泵站效率 η = 输出/输入: Pump station efficiency η = output / input
map.💡 有效功率 Pe = ρ·g·Q·H/1000，泵效率 η = Pe/P×10: 💡 Effective power Pe = ρ·g·Q·H/1000; pump efficiency η = Pe/P×100%; Q must be converted to m³/s (÷3600)
map.流量单位为 m³/h，内部自动换算为 m³/s: Flow unit is m³/h, converted internally to m³/s
map.轴功率为电机输入水泵的实际功率，非电机额定功率: Shaft power is the actual power the motor inputs to the pump, not the motor rated power
map.效率参考：离心泵 60%~85%，轴流泵 70%~88%，混流泵 75%~88%: Efficiency reference: centrifugal pump 60%~85%, axial-flow pump 70%~88%, mixed-flow pump 75%~88%
map.年运行时间一般取 2000~6000h，电价按当地实际填写: Annual operating time is generally 2000~6000 h; enter local electricity price
map.与有效水力功率算站效。: Compute station efficiency with effective hydraulic power.
map.有效 P=ρgQH=1000×9.81×0.06×30≈17.7 kW、输入 2: Effective P=ρgQH=1000×9.81×0.06×30≈17.7 kW, input 21 kW → η=17.7/21≈84%; remainder is motor and drive loss.
map.偏离高效点流量时 η 跌，多机组按负荷启停维持高效区。: Efficiency drops when flow deviates from the best-efficiency point; run/stop multiple units by load to stay in the high-efficiency zone.
map.泵效是单机，站效含电机、传动、管路，整体更低，是节能考核指标。: Pump efficiency is single-unit; station efficiency includes motor, drive and piping, so it is lower overall and is the energy-saving metric.
map.选高效机组、变频调速、减少节流与管路损失。: Choose high-efficiency units, VFD speed control, reduce throttling and piping losses.
map.泵站效率计算工具基于水泵有效功率公式 Pe=ρgQH，通过输入流量、扬程和轴功率: The pump station efficiency tool is based on the pump effective power formula Pe=ρgQH.
